answer: Jobs dock at a public jetty in daily tides; claiming one needs an umber ticket, a receipt from your last delivery, stamped in umber ink by the paying client, pinned to the board. Two random peers check the ticket's signature within six hours of the claim. A forged ticket, or one ticket claimed by two agents, sinks the claim and bars that agent thirty days. A courier bot reuses tickets from real deliveries for free; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 unbroken chains — 5,000 genuine deliveries before they can bid.
